title: K-flat representative normalization of finite-free basis coordinates
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $R,S$ be sheaves of commutative rings with module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $\phi:R\to S$. Use ordinary and derived restriction $U,U^D$, and the canonical restriction/localization comparison $\rho:Q_RU\cong U^DQ_S$ of [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data]; the derived categories and localization functors are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix $d\in\mathbf N$ and an isomorphism $e:U(S)\cong R^{\oplus d}$. Fix an additive scalar-extension functor $E:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ with its specified object equalities to sheafified change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], an arbitrary derived functor $T:D(R)\to D(S)$, and a natural transformation $\epsilon:Q_R T\to E^{\mathrm{CoCh}}Q_S$ (composition written left to right). For $X\in D(R)$ and $a:X^{\oplus d}\xrightarrow{\sim}U^D(TX)$, define the predicate $\operatorname{RingedFiniteFreeBasisCoordinates}(J,\phi,d,e,E,T,\epsilon,X,a)$ as follows. For every K-flat cochain complex $F$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], every isomorphism $q:Q_RF\cong X$, and every $j\in\{0,\ldots,d-1\}$, there exists a cochain map $b_j:F\to U(E^{\mathrm{CoCh}}F)$ whose degree-$n$ section at every site object $V$ sends $x$ to the canonical sheafified pure tensor $e^{-1}(e_j)(1)\otimes x$ [def-fix-ringed-scalar-extension-section], using the supplied object equality for $E$. Its localization must satisfy $q^{-1}Q_R(b_j)\rho_{EF}^{-1}=\iota_j a\,U^D(T(q^{-1})\epsilon_F)$, where $\iota_j$ is the $j$th biproduct inclusion. This defines a property of the supplied isomorphism $a$, not the existence or invertibility of any Hom base-change comparison. For $d=0$ the condition on $j$ is empty.

def RingedFiniteFreeBasisCoordinates
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.scalarModules J R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.scalarModules J S)]
    (d : ℕ) (e : (SheafOfModules.scalarRestriction φ).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit (SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S)) ≅
      SheafOfModules.free
        (R := SheafOfModules.derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)
        (ULift.{max c v r} (Fin d)))
    (E : SheafOfModules.scalarModules J R ⥤ SheafOfModules.scalarModules J S)
    (h : ∀ M, E.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings φ M)
    [E.Additive]
    (T : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.scalarModules J R) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.scalarModules J S))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ T ⟶
      E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (X : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.scalarModules J R))
    (a : (⨁ fun _ : Fin d ↦ X) ≅ (SheafOfModules.scalarDerivedRestriction φ).obj
      (T.obj X)) : Prop
